method: Reviewed the complete lesson, metadata checkpoints, historical DATA entry, prior ERR-077 verifier and current official Anthropic tool-call documentation. The W6 offline verifier compiles the complete Python sample and exercises malformed tool-use correlation IDs plus Anthropic-style usage validation. No provider calls were made.

observations.trace: Missing and duplicate tool_use IDs stop the whole batch before check_item dispatch; valid token counts sum to 17 in the fixture; booleans and negative required/cache counts are rejected. The prior complete lesson verifier remains 27/27.

limitations: The 2026-10-08 historical token totals, endpoint/model fingerprint, cache usage, task mapping and scorer remain unavailable and were not independently reproduced.
The synthetic tool and usage fixtures validate local control flow only; no provider, database, production authorization, concurrency or downstream side effect was tested.

The token helper treats absent or null optional cache fields as zero under the Anthropic-shaped fixture; compatibility endpoints must be checked for field and default semantics before interpreting totals.
